---
title: "concordance.csv: the full concordance"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("_preview.R")
```

The full Master Concordance, one row per xpath, for all forms and schedules
(990, 990-EZ, 990-PF and Schedules A to R), in the v1 column layout. This page
is built from the package with `concordance("v1")`, the same call that writes
`concordance.csv` at the root of the
[repository](https://github.com/Nonprofit-Open-Data-Collective/concordance990),
so the table and the download always match the package. The 990-PF database
on its own is [concordance-990pf.csv](concordance-990pf-csv.html).

The columns are described in [The component tables](table-structure.html) and
each variable in the [data dictionaries](data-dictionary-990.html). R users can
skip the file: `concordance990::concordance()` returns the same table.

```{r table, results = "asis"}
cat(preview_page(file = "concordance.csv"))
```
